schema: nfs-ea-import-plan/1 (own schema; not gamehub-cli datastore: that tool lacks hardlink/clone/registry ops)
status: PLAN ONLY - not applied; Phase 2 is run by the user with EA stopped
allowedRoots: /Volumes/ExT2/GameHub/Prefix/system.reg (written only by wine reg import in S5 / reg delete in R1; the documented last-resort manual-append fallback in S5 edits it directly with no wine process running)
envNote: Bash array W=(env -i <these>) in step S0; start-ea.sh's environment minus graphics-only variables. WINEMSYNC=1 is required. USER=Player does not change the Wine profile name, which is `crossover` in SP. Use it for every wine/wineserver command.
waiting: No sleep. Events: wineserver -w; ~/.agent-harness/bin/work wait --log PATH PATTERN --timeout 570 (exit 124 = call again).

decisions.title: Target path
decisions.text: NEW=/Volumes/ExT2/GameHub/EA Games/Need for Speed (E:\EA Games\Need for Speed\), outside the library root E:\EA Games\BF4\ on purpose; installCheck detection does not depend on the library root.

decisions.title: Hard-link mirror, not symlink
decisions.text: Rename OLD to NEW (same device, same inodes), then recreate OLD as a real tree of 144 hard links. The old wrapper resolves components below drive_c with GuestPath.resolve(followingLinks:false) and throws 'A Windows folder entry is a link: <name>' (GameHub/work/wt-hub-a/Sources/LauncherCore/GuestPath.swift:82-84 via Sources/NFS2015Core/NFS2015Install.swift:171-172, every launch; identical to commit 13d1f4f and the bundle). It checks only isSymbolicLink. Caveat: EA updates (write-new+rename) diverge NEW from the mirror and keep the old inodes alive (disk use grows by the patched size).

decisions.title: Registry
decisions.text: Only the NFS-prefix shape in the 32-bit view HKLM\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\EA Games\Need for Speed, Install Dir rewritten to E:\\EA Games\\Need for Speed\\, imported with wine reg import while EA is stopped.

decisions.title: No InstallData/Uninstall/GDF fabrication
decisions.text: The NFS prefix proves EA marks NFS Installed without them. Non-fatal: 'Could not parse uninstallCommandLine=[] of offerId=[Origin.OFR.50.0000810]'.

decisions.title: Licence not copied
decisions.text: The licence binds to more than the machash (BF3 70619.dlf mismatch after e: was added although machash stayed constant). NFS's dlf was issued with c:+z:; the shared prefix is c:+e:+z:. Never add or remove drive letters in SP.

decisions.title: Activation budget
decisions.text: First Play = 1 EA activation (EA's published user-agreement limit: 5 unique machines/activations per rolling 24 h; not verified here) plus a possible Denuvo activation; no other runtime switch or sign-in that day.

decisions.title: Old prefix
decisions.text: Only change: its game folder's files become hard links. Registry, licence, saves and runtime untouched.

licence.action: do not copy; EA issues a fresh 1024486.dlf on first Play
licence.activationCap: EA's published user-agreement limit: 5 unique machines/activations per rolling 24 h (not verified here)
licence.failureTest: licence-failure line count in gl_log_*.log (UTF-16LE) after Play greater than before Play (L1 > L0); old BF3 lines already exist (10 at the dry-run) and carry no content ID
licence.recovery: R2: move the new dlf aside, retry once

registry.rollback: reg delete of that key (and the native key only if a touchup created it); never the parent EA Games

steps.title: Variables
steps.notes: Run `bash` first (login shell is fish). TS=${TS:-...}; for a new window or rollback set TS=<original> and paste S0. Defines BK, W (env -i array), helpers jr/inv/stopped/lic_bad. Wine user profile inside SP is `crossover`. No set -e in the interactive shell; later blocks are ( set -euo pipefail ... ) subshells.
commands:
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
TS=${TS:-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)}
H=/Volumes/ExT2/GameHub
SP=$H/Prefix
OP=$H/Relocated/NFS2015Mac/Data/Prefix
OPALIAS="/Users/gc/Library/Application Support/NFS2015Mac/Data/Prefix"
OLD="$OP/drive_c/Program Files/EA Games/Need for Speed"
NEW="$H/EA Games/Need for Speed"
RT=$H/Runtimes/hub-0-winemacfs-dxmtrtv
PLAN=$H/docs/nfs-ea-import-20261011
REG=$PLAN/nfs-import.reg
DRY=$PLAN/nfs-ea-import-dryrun.sh
BK=$H/Backups/nfs-ea-import-$TS
WORK=$HOME/.agent-harness/bin/work
BR="/Users/gc/Library/Application Support/BF3Mac"
SPLIC="$SP/drive_c/ProgramData/Electronic Arts/EA Services/License"
LOGD="$SP/drive_c/ProgramData/EA Desktop/Logs"
BSV="$LOGD/EABackgroundServiceVerbose.log"
HDR='[Software\\Wow6432Node\\EA Games\\Need for Speed]'
W=(env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin LANG=en_US.UTF-8 USER=Player HOME="$BR/RuntimeHome/Player" TMPDIR="$BR/Temporary" WINEPREFIX="$SP" WINEDEBUG=-all WINEMSYNC=1 ROSETTA_X87_PATH="$H/Runtimes/hub-0-helpers/x87sidecar" WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winemenubuilder.exe=d")
jr() { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$*" >> "$BK/journal.txt"; }
inv() { (cd "$1" && /usr/bin/find . -type f -print0 | xargs -0 /usr/bin/stat -f '%i%t%l%t%z%t%N') | LC_ALL=C sort -t "$(printf '\t')" -k4,4; }
stopped() { local o; o=$(/bin/bash "$DRY" --gate) || true; printf '%s\n' "$o" | grep -q '^DRYRUN gate ' || { echo "dry-run did not run"; return 1; }; ! printf '%s\n' "$o" | grep -E '^\[FAIL\] (noWineProcess|prefixNotInUse|old wrapper)'; }
lic_bad() { for f in "$SP/drive_c/ProgramData/EA Logs"/gl_log_*.log; do iconv -f UTF-16LE -t UTF-8 "$f" 2>/dev/null; done | grep -acE 'Mismatched machine hash|License Failure' || true; }
echo "TS=$TS"; echo "BK=$BK"

steps.title: Stop everything, then run the apply gate
steps.notes: Pause BF1 and any download in EA's Downloads queue (the installer-process count cannot see downloads), then Quit EA from its menu; also quit games and the old NFS wrapper. Wait for the shared wineserver to exit (no sleep), then the gate must pass every check. Fallback: taskkill list, last resort wineserver -k.

preconditions.text: BF1 and other downloads paused or finished in EA's Downloads queue

verify.method: no open file under the prefix (one lsof -nP -F n), no holder of /tmp/.wine-<uid>/server-<hex st_dev>-<hex st_ino>/socket (also /private/tmp), no process command line naming the prefix

fallbackCommands:
for p in EADesktop.exe EACefSubProcess.exe EABackgroundService.exe EAGEP.exe; do "${W[@]}" "$RT/bin/wine" taskkill /f /im "$p"; done
"${W[@]}" "$RT/bin/wineserver" -w
# last resort only, loses unflushed EA state:
"${W[@]}" "$RT/bin/wineserver" -k; "${W[@]}" "$RT/bin/wineserver" -w

steps.title: Backups (no wine)
steps.notes: Cloned copies (cp -c) of both prefixes' three .reg files, shared ProgramData/EA Desktop and License dirs, old License dir, the .reg file. Game data is NOT copied, only an inode inventory. SHA256SUMS relative to files/; SHA256SUMS.meta covers game-inventory-before.tsv and nfs-import.reg.

preconditions.note: first line of every mutating block: dry-run --gate with no FAIL on noWineProcess / prefixNotInUse / old wrapper

commands:
( set -euo pipefail
  stopped || { echo "wine/EA/old wrapper still running: quit them and re-run S1"; exit 1; }
  [ ! -e "$BK" ] || { echo "BK exists: $BK"; exit 1; }
  mkdir -p "$BK/files/shared" "$BK/files/old-nfs"
  jr "S2 start: stopped check passed (EA, games, old wrapper not running)"
  for f in system.reg user.reg userdef.reg; do
    /bin/cp -c -p "$SP/$f" "$BK/files/shared/$f"
    /bin/cp -c -p "$OP/$f" "$BK/files/old-nfs/$f"
  done
  mkdir -p "$BK/files/shared/ProgramData/Electronic Arts/EA Services" "$BK/files/old-nfs/ProgramData/Electronic Arts/EA Services"
  /bin/cp -c -R -p "$SP/drive_c/ProgramData/EA Desktop" "$BK/files/shared/ProgramData/EA Desktop"
  /bin/cp -c -R -p "$SPLIC" "$BK/files/shared/ProgramData/Electronic Arts/EA Services/License"
  /bin/cp -c -R -p "$OP/drive_c/ProgramData/Electronic Arts/EA Services/License" "$BK/files/old-nfs/ProgramData/Electronic Arts/EA Services/License"
  /bin/cp -p "$REG" "$BK/nfs-import.reg"
  inv "$OLD" > "$BK/game-inventory-before.tsv"
  [ "$(wc -l < "$BK/game-inventory-before.tsv" | tr -d ' ')" = 144 ] || { echo "inventory is not 144 lines"; exit 1; }
  awk -F'\t' '$2 != 1 { bad++ } END { exit bad > 0 }' "$BK/game-inventory-before.tsv" || { echo "a game file has link count != 1"; exit 1; }
  ( cd "$BK/files" && /usr/bin/find . -type f -print0 | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 ) > "$BK/SHA256SUMS"
  ( cd "$BK/files" && /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 -c ../SHA256SUMS > /dev/null )
  ( cd "$BK" && /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 game-inventory-before.tsv nfs-import.reg > SHA256SUMS.meta && /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.meta > /dev/null )
  jr "S2 OK: $(wc -l < "$BK/SHA256SUMS" | tr -d ' ') files hashed, inventory 144 lines"
  echo "S2 OK: $BK" ); echo "S2 rc=$?"

steps.title: Move the game folder (rename, not copy)
steps.notes: mv -n OLD NEW on the same APFS device. BSD mv -n exits 0 when it does nothing, so existence is checked after. The inode inventory must be identical afterwards.

preconditions.note: first line of every mutating block: dry-run --gate with no FAIL on noWineProcess / prefixNotInUse / old wrapper

steps.notes: Real directory tree at OLD with 144 hard links to NEW. No symlink anywhere (old wrapper throws 'A Windows folder entry is a link'). If it stops midway run R0 (S4-undo).

steps.title: Registry import (wine allowed, EA stopped)
steps.notes: wine reg import of nfs-import.reg into the 32-bit view only, then wineserver -k and -w so the hive is flushed. Verify on disk read-only: the section is extracted with awk (header to next '[' line) and the three values are looked up in it; counts of BF3/BF4/Crysis/F1_24 lines must not change. Fallback (not recommended): append the section to system.reg with no wine running.

preconditions.note: first line of every mutating block: dry-run --gate with no FAIL on noWineProcess / prefixNotInUse / old wrapper

commands:
( set -euo pipefail
  stopped || { echo "wine/EA/old wrapper still running: quit them and re-run S1"; exit 1; }
  [ -f "$BK/game-inventory-before.tsv" ] || { echo "BK is wrong: set TS to the original value"; exit 1; }
  for p in 'Battlefield 4' 'Battlefield 3' 'Crysis' 'F1_24' 'Need for Speed'; do
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$(grep -cF "$p" "$SP/system.reg" || true)"
  done | tee "$BK/reg-counts-before.txt"
  "${W[@]}" "$RT/bin/wine" reg import 'Z:\Volumes\ExT2\GameHub\docs\nfs-ea-import-20261011\nfs-import.reg'
  jr "S5 reg import rc=0"
  "${W[@]}" "$RT/bin/wineserver" -k || true
  "${W[@]}" "$RT/bin/wineserver" -w
  jr "S5 wineserver stopped"
  echo "S5 import OK" ); echo "S5 rc=$?"
verifyCommands:
( set -euo pipefail
  SEC=$(HDR="$HDR" awk 'index($0,ENVIRON["HDR"])==1{f=1;next} f&&/^\[/{exit} f' "$SP/system.reg")
  printf '%s\n' "$SEC"
  [ "$(grep -cF "$HDR" "$SP/system.reg")" = 1 ] || { echo "header count != 1"; exit 1; }
  for l in '"Install Dir"="E:\\EA Games\\Need for Speed\\"' '"Locale"="en_US"' '"Product GUID"="{F8643E83-A868-4EE8-A0B9-389386830453}"'; do
    printf '%s\n' "$SEC" | grep -qxF "$l" || { echo "MISSING: $l"; exit 1; }
  done
  for p in 'Battlefield 4' 'Battlefield 3' 'Crysis' 'F1_24'; do
    before=$(awk -F'\t' -v p="$p" '$1 == p { print $2 }' "$BK/reg-counts-before.txt")
    now=$(grep -cF "$p" "$SP/system.reg" || true)
    [ "$before" = "$now" ] || { echo "COUNT CHANGED for $p: $before -> $now"; exit 1; }
  done
  jr "S5 verified: NFS key present, other game keys unchanged"
  echo "S5 verify OK" ); echo "S5 verify rc=$?"
fallbackCommands:
( set -euo pipefail
  stopped || { echo "wine/EA/old wrapper still running: quit them and re-run S1"; exit 1; }
  /bin/cp -c -p "$SP/system.reg" "$BK/files/shared/system.reg.pre-manual-edit"
  printf '
[Software\\Wow6432Node\\EA Games\\Need for Speed] %s
"Install Dir"="E:\\EA Games\\Need for Speed\\"
"Locale"="en_US"
"Product GUID"="{F8643E83-A868-4EE8-A0B9-389386830453}"
' "$(date +%s)" >> "$SP/system.reg"
  echo "appended" ); echo "manual-edit rc=$?"
rollback:
( set -euo pipefail
  [ -f "$BK/game-inventory-before.tsv" ] || { echo "BK is wrong: set TS to the original value"; exit 1; }
  stopped || { echo "wine/EA/old wrapper still running: quit them and re-run S1"; exit 1; }
  if "${W[@]}" "$RT/bin/wine" reg query 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\EA Games\Need for Speed' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    "${W[@]}" "$RT/bin/wine" reg delete 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\EA Games\Need for Speed' /f
  fi
  if "${W[@]}" "$RT/bin/wine" reg query 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\EA Games\Need for Speed' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    "${W[@]}" "$RT/bin/wine" reg delete 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\EA Games\Need for Speed' /f
  fi
  "${W[@]}" "$RT/bin/wineserver" -k || true
  "${W[@]}" "$RT/bin/wineserver" -w
  [ "$(grep -cF "$HDR" "$SP/system.reg" || true)" = 0 ] || { echo "NFS key still present"; exit 1; }
  grep -nE 'Need for Speed|F8643E83' "$SP/system.reg" || echo "no NFS leftovers"
  jr "R1 NFS registry keys removed"
  echo "R1 OK" ); echo "R1 rc=$?"

steps.title: Start EA and verify detection
steps.notes: Records log byte offsets, starts EA, work wait --log only when the stale-match count is 0 (it scans from offset 0), then verifies four lines read only from the recorded offsets (rotated log read whole; .bak searched on a miss). Evidence is from the old prefix's EA 13.805.11.6320; SP runs 13.805.99.0. Contingency: watchPath path [E: still MISS after two waits -> open question (c), native key.
commands:
OFF_BSV=$(wc -c < "$BSV" | tr -d ' '); OFF_ED=$(wc -c < "$LOGD/EADesktop.log" | tr -d ' ')
echo "${OFF_BSV:-0} ${OFF_ED:-0}" > "$BK/log-offsets.txt"
STALE=$(grep -ac 'Located files for software \[Origin\.SFT\.50\.0000347\]' "$BSV" || true)
echo "stale matches before start (work wait needs 0): $STALE"
/Volumes/ExT2/GameHub/bin/start-ea.sh
if [ "$STALE" = 0 ]; then
  "$WORK" wait --log "$BSV" 'Located files for software \[Origin\.SFT\.50\.0000347\]\. Setting state to Installed' --timeout 570
  echo "work rc=$? (124 = not yet; run just the wait line again)"
else
  echo "stale lines exist: skip work wait and run the verify block below repeatedly"
fi

verify.text: watchPath path [E:\EA Games\Need for Speed\NFS16.exe] for software [Origin.SFT.50.0000347]
Located files for software [Origin.SFT.50.0000347]. Setting state to Installed
IS update: set installInfo for softwareId=[Origin.SFT.50.0000347] baseSlug=[need-for-speed] installedStatus=[Installed]

verifyCommands:
( set -u; bad=0
  read OFF_BSV OFF_ED < "$BK/log-offsets.txt"
  chk() { local f=$1 off=$2 t=$3 sz; sz=$(wc -c < "$f" | tr -d ' ')
    if [ "$sz" -lt "$off" ]; then off=0; fi
    if tail -c +"$((off + 1))" "$f" | grep -aqF -- "$t"; then echo "OK   $t"
    elif [ -f "${f%.log}.bak" ] && grep -aqF -- "$t" "${f%.log}.bak"; then echo "OK   (in .bak) $t"
    else echo "MISS $t"; bad=1; fi; }
  chk "$BSV" "$OFF_BSV" 'watchPath path [E:\EA Games\Need for Speed\NFS16.exe] for software [Origin.SFT.50.0000347]'
  chk "$BSV" "$OFF_BSV" 'Located files for software [Origin.SFT.50.0000347]. Setting state to Installed'
  chk "$BSV" "$OFF_BSV" 'launcher.exePath=[[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\EA Games\Need for Speed\Install Dir]NFS16.exe]'
  chk "$LOGD/EADesktop.log" "$OFF_ED" 'IS update: set installInfo for softwareId=[Origin.SFT.50.0000347] baseSlug=[need-for-speed] installedStatus=[Installed]'
  exit $bad ); echo "S6 verify rc=$?"

steps.title: First launch and licence (user-driven)
steps.notes: Record L0=lic_bad BEFORE Play, press Play, then L1=lic_bad. Failure iff L1 > L0 (BF3's old Mismatched-machine-hash lines are already in gl_log_2.log and carry no content ID). EA issues a fresh 1024486.dlf (1 EA activation, possibly 1 Denuvo activation). Disable auto-update for NFS in EA before Play.
commands:
L0=$(lic_bad); echo "$L0" > "$BK/lic-bad-before.txt"; jr "S7 before Play: licence-failure lines=$L0"
echo "licence-failure lines before Play: $L0"
verifyCommands:
( set -u
  L0=$(cat "$BK/lic-bad-before.txt"); L1=$(lic_bad)
  echo "licence-failure lines before=$L0 after=$L1 (after > before = failure)"
  if [ "$L1" -gt "$L0" ]; then echo "LICENCE FAILURE: see R2"; else echo "licence OK"; fi
  ls -l "$SPLIC/1024486.dlf"
  grep -ac 'License signature is good' "$SP/drive_c/ProgramData/Origin/Logs/NFS16_1024486_OnlineActivation_Log.html"
  grep -ahF 'Got exePath=[E:\EA Games\Need for Speed\NFS16.exe]' "$LOGD/EADesktop.log" | tail -1 )
